text.p: Pen pictures of the probable Porto team for Saturday's first division match with Benfica:

Henrique Hilario. Goalkeeper, 21. Took over the gloves after Vitor Baia left for Barcelona and has proved a fine replacement. Went 685 minutes without conceding a goal after his debut in October. Inspires confidence in his defenders.
Paulinho Santos. Defender or midfielder, 27. Multi-skilled, utility player although he feels more at home in the midfield. Has a powerful shot and is a free-kick specialist.
Fernando Mendes. Defender, 31. Veteran whose fine form this season earned him a call up to the national squad last month after a three-year absence. Likes to attack down the left.
Jorge Costa. Central defender, 25. Tough and aggressive marker. Just returned from a six-week lay-off after having his nose broken by AC Milan striker George Weah at the end of a European Cup match.
Aloisio Alves. Defender, 33. Veteran Brazilian who forms imposing defensive barrier beside Costa.
Jose Barroso. Midfielder, 25. Skilled ball-winner. A key player both in defence and attack, with a powerful shot.

Zlatko Zahovic. Midfielder, 25. The Slovenian joined Porto this season from Guimaraes in a controversial transfer that marred relations between the two clubs. Creative left-footer who is the "boss" of the midfield.
Ljubimko Drulovic. Midfielder, 28. Serbian playmaker who recently fulfilled his ambition to play for Yugoslavia, scoring in a 3-2 win against Argentina. Has a sweet left foot.
Edmilson Pimenta, Striker, 25. The Brazilian likes to roam, posing a headache for opponents seeking to mark him. Fine ball skills.

Artur Oliveira, Striker, 27. Another Brazilian, switched from fellow Oporto side Boavista at the start of the season. Small and fast. He has played a key part in Porto's successful run in the European Cup this season.

Mario Jardel, Striker, 23. Knicknamed "Matador" (Killer) by Porto fans, he completes the club's Brazilian strike force. Top scorer in the league with 12 goals in his first season since being bought from Brazil's Gremio. Has the priceless striker's art of being in the right place at the right time.
